# Random Number

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Get's a random number between the provided max and min.

## Syntax

~~~~text
randomNumber(min: <#Number (Allows Variables)#>, max: <#Number (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
randomNumber(min: 0, max: 100)
~~~~
